steps.observation: You have 60 seconds. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
1. Boost low-carbon transport  
  • Expand and electrify public transit (buses, trams, subways)  
  • Build safe walking and cycling networks  
  • Incentivize electric vehicles with charging infrastructure and parking perks  

2. Green and retrofit buildings  
  • Tighten energy-efficiency codes for new construction  
  • Offer grants or low-interest loans for insulation, efficient HVAC, LED lighting  
  • Mandate smart meters and automated energy management  

3. Scale up clean energy and smart grids  
  • Install rooftop solar, community solar farms, and district heating/cooling  
  • Integrate battery storage and demand-response systems  
  • Implement urban microgrids and real-time monitoring to balance load and renewables
